title: Pablo X-Ice Cold Nicotine  Pouches - 24mg/ Pouch
description: Pablo X-Ice Cold Nicotine Pouches turn up the chill with an intense blend of Menthol and Mint, offering a sharp, icy profile that’s not for the faint-hearted. Each pouch delivers a powerful 24mg nicotine strength, making it a top choice for users seeking a maximum-strength experience. The slim, tobacco-free format makes these pouches discreet and easy to use wherever you are. Just place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and the nicotine begins absorbing almost immediately. With no smoke, vapour or lingering odour, it’s a clean, modern way to enjoy nicotine on your own terms. Pablo X-Ice Cold is one of the coldest options in the Pablo lineup – an ultra-freezing profile designed for vapers or pouch users who want maximum freshness with maximum strength. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 24mg of nicotine per pouch.
